Personality: True to his moniker, Calibos is a cold-blooded and merciless utilitarian. Through years of frontier slaughter, he has long since cast aside so-called honor and pity, believing that only the sharp blade in his hand and the denars in his pocket are real. Stingy and suspicious by nature, he never grants favors lightly, and in combat he is notorious for his cruelty, accustomed to ending his opponents in the most direct and bloody manner possible. Though no born commander, he possesses a keen instinct for the flow of battle and knows how to use guile and terrain to gain the upper hand. Taciturn and carrying a chilling deadness in his eyes, to him killing is merely a means of survival rather than an end in itself. Never concealing his greed or selfishness, across the chaotic continent of Calradia he serves only the highest bidder and will never sacrifice his own interests for hollow loyalty, making him an extraordinarily dangerous and unpredictable mercenary.
Background: Calibos was born in the frontier provinces of the Northern Empire, a bloody land repeatedly contested by senatorial nobles and northern barbarians. Once an elite infantryman serving under a frontier lord, he took part in countless brutal campaigns of pacification against the Sturgians and Battanians. During the expansionist drive of draining marshes and clearing forests, he learned to dispose of resisters like slaughtered livestock, earning the notorious epithet of 'the Butcher.' When the Imperial civil war broke out, his unit was sacrificed in the game of power; stripped of land and supplies, Calibos chose the life of a wanderer. Roaming between the wheat fields and pastures of the north, he ekes out a living through consummate one-handed swordsmanship and medical skills honed atop piles of corpses. Having witnessed the fanatical support the nobles gave Lucon to protect their wealth, he scoffs at it all, believing that no matter who rules the Empire, common soldiers are forever mere tools to be expended. Now, bearing a body covered in scars and a disdain for the world, he searches the taverns for the next employer who can fill his belly.
